name: Kufsteiner Hof
beschreibung: The traditional Kufsteiner Hof welcomes corporate and leisure guests to the heart of the fortress town of Kufstein, only moments from the central railway station and the historic Old Town by the Inn River. The comfortable guest rooms offer contemporary urban styling and amenities. A standout feature is the rooftop Sky-Spa, boasting saunas, a steam bath, and a panoramic open-air terrace with sweeping views of Kufstein Fortress and the Kaisergebirge. The hotel restaurant serves traditional Tyrolean cuisine alongside international culinary favorites. Its central setting ensures rapid access to surrounding alpine lakes and winter sports resorts.
kurzbeschreibung: Centrally located hotel in Kufstein featuring on-site dining, a rooftop Sky-Spa, and fortress views near the old town.
